verdict.rationale: Glama's docs show pre-filled configs only for MCP clients like Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and VS Code (glama-docs-13, glama-docs-25, glama-docs-26); there is no mention of adapters or integration guides for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs anywhere in the evidence pack.
